experiment: E3 — B5 threshold selection and held-out evaluation
objective: Select exactly one B5 operating point from the registered 60-point grid using validation only, then evaluate it once on held-out data. The primary question is whether new B5 improves separation relative to B2 volume-only.
scope: Offline analysis of controlled synthetic E2 detector-decision records. No claim is made about real IP fragmentation, DNS cache-poisoning prevention, attack success rate (ASR), latency, throughput, CPU, memory, or deployment performance.

partition.strategy: new E3 60/20/20 repartition by paired trace

train_exploration.permitted_use: schema, pairing, and implementation QA only; it must not select an operating point

validation.permitted_use: score all 60 candidates and select exactly one operating point

held_out_test.permitted_use: evaluate the locked operating point exactly once after the lock gate passes

partition.provenance_note: These are new E3 partitions derived from the canonical E2 decision dataset; they are not the original E2 calibration/validation/test partitions. All decision windows from a paired trace remain in one E3 partition.

decision_rule.new_B5_block: samples >= min_samples AND entropy >= entropy_threshold AND unique_ratio >= unique_ratio_threshold
decision_rule.old_B5_grid_role: The old B5 point is included in the registered grid and is also reported as a comparator.

pair_metric.attack_alert_rate: mean(new_B5_block) in an attack paired trace
pair_metric.benign_trigger_rate: mean(new_B5_block) in its matching benign paired trace

selection.aggregation: equal-weight macro-average over the 2 primary attack conditions x 4 levels; pair-level values are the independent observations

failure_probe_treatment.selection_role: report separately; do not use as a selection constraint

negative_control_treatment.selection_role: report separately; do not use as a selection constraint

tie_breaking_in_order: lower macro benign_trigger_rate on primary cells
higher macro attack_alert_rate on primary cells

held_out_metrics: AUPRC for individual continuous features where applicable

asr.reason: E2 records feature values, synthetic event composition, and detector block decisions, but no poisoning attempt/success outcome, DNS answer, cache state, or end-to-end resolver outcome. Attack-alert must not be interpreted as ASR or poisoning prevention.

inference_and_reporting.interpretation: Synthetic attack-alert/TPR and benign-trigger/FPR describe detector behavior in controlled synthetic conditions only.

provenance.source_code_status: No E3 validation-selection or held-out-test scoring code has been run at registration time.
